Name: Healthy blobfish
Author: whitebalverines
Description:
[center]As per request, here's a sprite replaement for the blobfish!
This just changes it to look how it does in its natural habitat.

[b]Installation:[/b]
Just place the [CP] folder with your mods! It just edits the blobfish image and doesn't touch any of the rest of springobjects.

[b]Credits:[/b]
[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/24986819-gervig91/]Gervig91[/url] for animated sprites and mask replacement!
-The sprite is set to animated by default, but you can change this with the config file after starting up your game!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yzVQrEa.gif[/img]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/v6J6jBf.png[/img]﻿

[b]Disclaimer: [/b]
I am well aware that the fish looks how it does when it is removed from where it's supposed to live. This is just a simple sprite for a fantasy game to make a fish look a little less sad a more healthy :P[/center]
